sentences.en: It took her eight frustrating hours to seduce the bookkeeper.
sentences.zh: 她花了八个小时才说服那个出纳员。

sentences.en: Sami was seduced by the videos posted by ISIS online.
sentences.zh: 萨米被ISIS在网上发布的视频所吸引。

sentences.en: This guy is quick in seducing women so you better beware.
sentences.zh: 这家伙很会勾引女人，你最好小心点。

senses.zh: 勾引，引诱,诱奸（妇女）,诱使…堕落,迷惑，使入迷
